objective: Distributed Orchestration with Mediators, HITL Governance, GCP Attribution (DAK), Parallel Fan-Out Execution, and Read-After-Write Verification in 3 Waves
acceptance_criteria: Wave 1 (intent_hitl_mediator): Classify intent via strict Pydantic schema (extra='forbid'), pause/validate critical mutations via HITL (approval_token + idempotency_key), and enforce GCP resource attribution (--label datacloud:antigravity on bq query/load/extract/mk/update/cp and CLOUDSDK_METRICS_ENVIRONMENT on gcloud)
Wave 2A (parallel_domain_workers): Execute parallel fan-out of specialist subagents (UX/Vision, SEO/Metadata, Copy/Content, AST Math) into isolated state keys without collisions
Wave 2B (mcp_stateless_dispatcher): Execute stateless JSON-RPC 2.0 calls with _meta envelope (MCP Protocol 2026-07-28) and idempotency tracking
Wave 3 (read_after_write_verifier): Perform explicit post-write read verification (Read-After-Write) on real state and emit signed verdict with post_condition_verified = true

tasks.description: Wave 1 (Ingress Mediator): Pydantic v2 intent triage, HITL policy gate (checkpoint + idempotency_key), and DAK label enforcement (enforcing-resource-attribution)
Wave 2A (Parallel Fan-Out): Concurrent execution of UX, SEO, Copy, and AST Math subagents into isolated state keys
Wave 2B (MCP Bus 2026-07-28): Stateless JSON-RPC 2.0 dispatch with _meta envelope, HITL approval_token, and idempotency ledger
Wave 3 (Final Gatekeeper Mediator): Fan-In consolidation, explicit Read-After-Write verification, and real-state confirmation
